items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, Be Shea wasn't on Climax. Oh, wasn't he? Maybe he thought he was going to be. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, maybe, I don't know, I didn't.

ctx.x: He's got a note in here, to be Sidney. Must be, uh, to Paris.
Now, Be Shea wasn't on Climax. Oh, wasn't he? Maybe he thought he was going to be.
